definitions.explanation: A dog that is kept inside the house rather than outdoors. In modern Japan, most pet dogs are kept indoors.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{室内犬|しつないけん}です。
examples.english: Our dog is an indoor dog.

examples.japanese: {室内犬|しつないけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{小型犬|こがたけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧。
examples.english: Small breeds are suited for keeping indoors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大型犬|おおがたけん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{室内犬|しつないけん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, more people are keeping even large dogs as indoor dogs.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{室内|しつない}→室内：03061_shitsunai⟧ (indoors) and {犬|けん} (dog). Reflects the modern Japanese trend of keeping dogs inside the home rather than in an outdoor kennel.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {室内犬|しつないけん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{飼|か}う→飼う：08151_kau⟧ (to keep as an indoor dog)
- {室内犬|しつないけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}いている→向く：02304_muku⟧ (suited for keeping indoors)
- {室内犬|しつないけん}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{犬種|けんしゅ} (dog breeds suitable for indoor living)

RELATED WORDS:
- {室外犬|しつがいけん}: outdoor dog
- ⟦{番犬|ばんけん}→番犬：22378_banken⟧: guard dog
- ⟦{愛犬|あいけん}→愛犬：27504_aiken⟧: pet dog, beloved dog
